en: Black-and-white postcard image of a wooded valley with a narrow winding path. In the foreground, a rustic bridge or barrier made of intertwined branches crosses a small ditch. A person in early 20th‑century attire stands further up the path. Dense trees and foliage surround the path, creating a shaded forest scene. In the lower-left corner, caption text reads "Beek. Kastanjedal."
